summary: sextant-cli-darwin-arm64 ships a Mach-O binary providing PTY-over-WebSocket remote control and Anthropic credential harvest
details: The platform-binary package sextant-cli-darwin-arm64 ships a Mach-O executable that links github.com/creack/pty (PTY spawn) and github.com/coder/websocket and contains the hardcoded destinations wss://relay.sextant.top and https://relay.sextant.top/install. This wires a pseudo-terminal on the installer's macOS host to a WebSocket controlled by a remote party at relay.sextant.top, giving that party interactive shell/exec on the machine that installs and runs the CLI. The same binary embeds the Anthropic API key regex sk-ant-[a-z0-9]+-[A-Za-z0-9_-]{40,}, references CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR and api.anthropic.com/v1/models, and issues host geolocation/ASN reconnaissance via http://ip-api.com/json/?fields=status,message,country,countryCode,city,timezone,isp,org,as,proxy,hosting,mobile,query. package.json declares the license as "SEE LICENSE IN https://github.com/ddos798/claude_control", tying the binary to a repository explicitly named claude_control.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
